facts.fact: CIPESA reports that Lesotho's Draft Data Management Policy 2025 was the subject of a stakeholder workshop on 28-30 July 2025 and a validation workshop set for 13-14 October 2025.

LSO.note: Data Protection Act 2011 is named as part of the legislative framework analysed; no standing, authority, regulations or application stated.
CIPESA runs the workshops and its base in Lesotho is not stated; no local research institution shown.
CIPESA, not the government, is shown running the engagement on the draft policy; no government call for views stated.
